title: Verified sympy-sphinx deep campaign: three of ten resolved
goal: Run a ten-instance campaign over the sealed list in assets/gc-462/instances.txt, five sympy and five sphinx, finishing with at least three resolved under the swebench docker harness. The set concentrates on two deep codebases so that knowledge compounds across attempts: what you learn about sympy's printing and simplification internals on one instance should lower the cost of the next, and likewise for sphinx's autodoc pipeline. Plan the campaign to exploit that structure explicitly, stating after each attempt what transferred. Several gold patches exceed a hundred lines, so intermediate harness verification of candidate patches is mandatory before final submission, and each unresolved instance needs a named cause in the failure ledger. A red final run within budget requires a documented re-plan and re-run, not a silent stop.
resources: pypi: swebench==4.1.0 (evaluation harness; provides python3 -m swebench.harness.run_evaluation)

huggingface dataset: princeton-nlp/SWE-bench_Verified, test split, revision c104f840cc67f8b6eec6f759ebc8b2693d585d4a (pinned via the HF API; only the sealed ids in assets/gc-462/instances.txt are in scope)
docker images: swebench/sweb.eval.x86_64.<instance_id>:latest (pulled automatically by the harness, namespace 'swebench')
assets/gc-462/instances.txt (sealed instance-id list, one id per line; every id is in the Verified 500 split and none is in the Lite 300 split)
output convention: runs/gc-462/predictions.jsonl with model_name_or_path set exactly to 'gc-462', so the harness report is written to gc-462.<run_id>.json in the repo root

spec.command: python3 -m swebench.harness.run_evaluation --dataset_name princeton-nlp/SWE-bench_Verified --split test --predictions_path runs/gc-462/predictions.jsonl --instance_ids $(cat assets/gc-462/instances.txt) --max_workers 4 --report_dir . --run_id gc-462 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('gc-462.gc-462.json')); print(json.dumps({'resolved_instances': r['resolved_instances']}))"

process_expectations: A plan artifact exists at runs/gc-462/plan.md before the first patch attempt, naming target instance ids, suspected fault areas, and the exact verification command.
Verification actually ran: logs or shell history show at least one swebench harness execution on candidate patches before the final grading run, with its verdict recorded.
Failure identities are tracked: runs/gc-462/failures.md lists each unresolved or errored instance id with a one-line cause (failing test name or apply error), not just counts.
Honest cost and attempt logging: runs/gc-462/ledger.json records per-attempt LLM spend and outcome, including failed and abandoned attempts.
Recovery after RED: if any harness run misses the threshold, artifacts show a revised plan and a re-run rather than a silent stop.

No gold consultation: the public dataset carries gold and test patches for every instance; the trajectory must show independent diagnosis from the problem statement and repo, and neither patch may be read or reused.
